_readme: Bromic Training Hub (#/training): the curriculum. Decks are built by decks/training/<script>.js on decks/training/lib.js into decks/training/out/<file>.pptx and .pdf; build.mjs copies them with a cover image. Status 'ready' shows downloads; 'next' shows the course as coming.
